Read.description: Reads a data product from a given file location.

file.name: file
file.description: The file from which the data product is read. Value must not be empty.

formatName.name: formatName
formatName.description: An (optional) format name. Value must not be empty.

pixelRegion.name: pixelRegion
pixelRegion.description: The subset region in pixel coordinates. Use the following format: {x>,{y>,{width>,{height> If not given, the entire scene is used. The 'geoRegion' parameter has precedence over this parameter.

geometryRegion.name: geometryRegion
geometryRegion.description: The subset region in geographical coordinates using WKT-format, e.g. POLYGON(({lon1} {lat1}, {lon2} {lat2}, ..., {lon1} {lat1})) (make sure to quote the option due to spaces in {geometry}). If not given, the entire scene is used.

vectorFile.name: vectorFile
vectorFile.description: The file from which the polygon is read.

polygonRegion.name: polygonRegion
polygonRegion.description: The subset region in geographical coordinates using WKT-format, e.g. POLYGON(({lon1} {lat1}, {lon2} {lat2}, ..., {lon1} {lat1})) If not given, the geometryRegion or pixelRegion is used.

useAdvancedOptions.name: useAdvancedOptions
useAdvancedOptions.description: Whether to use advanced options for reading of the source product.

copyMetadata.name: copyMetadata
copyMetadata.description: Whether to copy the metadata of the source product.

TOPSAR-Split.description: Creates a new product with only the selected subswath

wktAoi.name: wktAoi
wktAoi.description: WKT polygon to be used for selecting bursts

Write.description: Writes a data product to a file.

file.name: file
file.description: The output file to which the data product is written.

formatName.name: formatName
formatName.description: The name of the output file format.

deleteOutputOnFailure.name: deleteOutputOnFailure
deleteOutputOnFailure.description: If true, all output files are deleted after a failed write operation.

writeEntireTileRows.name: writeEntireTileRows
writeEntireTileRows.description: If true, the write operation waits until an entire tile row is computed.

clearCacheAfterRowWrite.name: clearCacheAfterRowWrite
clearCacheAfterRowWrite.description: If true, the internal tile cache is cleared after a tile row has been written. Ignored if writeEntireTileRows=false.

Back-Geocoding.description: Bursts co-registration using orbit and DEM

resamplingType.name: resamplingType
resamplingType.description: The method to be used when resampling the slave grid onto the master grid.

Enhanced-Spectral-Diversity.description: Estimate constant range and azimuth offsets for a stack of images

cohThreshold.name: cohThreshold
cohThreshold.description: The coherence threshold for outlier removal

numBlocksPerOverlap.name: numBlocksPerOverlap
numBlocksPerOverlap.description: The number of windows per overlap for ESD

esdEstimator.name: esdEstimator
esdEstimator.description: ESD estimator used for azimuth shift computation

weightFunc.name: weightFunc
weightFunc.description: Weight function of the coherence to use for azimuth shift estimation

temporalBaselineType.name: temporalBaselineType
temporalBaselineType.description: Baseline type for building the integration network

maxTemporalBaseline.name: maxTemporalBaseline
maxTemporalBaseline.description: Maximum temporal baseline (in days or number of images depending on the Temporal baseline type) between pairs of images to construct the network. Any number < 1 will generate a network with all of the possible pairs.

integrationMethod.name: integrationMethod
integrationMethod.description: Method used for integrating the shifts network.

Interferogram.description: Compute interferograms from stack of coregistered S-1 images

srpNumberPoints.name: srpNumberPoints
srpNumberPoints.description: Number of points for the 'flat earth phase' polynomial estimation

cohWinAz.name: cohWinAz
cohWinAz.description: Size of coherence estimation window in Azimuth direction

cohWinRg.name: cohWinRg
cohWinRg.description: Size of coherence estimation window in Range direction

tileExtensionPercent.name: tileExtensionPercent
tileExtensionPercent.description: Define extension of tile for DEM simulation (optimization parameter).

tileExtensionPercent.name: tileExtensionPercent
tileExtensionPercent.description: Define extension of tile for DEM simulation (optimization parameter).

Multilook.description: Averages the power across a number of lines in both the azimuth and range directions

nRgLooks.name: nRgLooks
nRgLooks.description: The user defined number of range looks

nAzLooks.name: nAzLooks
nAzLooks.description: The user defined number of azimuth looks

outputIntensity.name: outputIntensity
outputIntensity.description: For complex product output intensity or i and q

Subset.description: Create a spatial and/or spectral subset of a data product.

tiePointGrids.name: tiePointGrids
tiePointGrids.description: The list of tie-point grid names.

region.name: region
region.description: The subset region in pixel coordinates. Use the following format: {x},{y},{width},{height} If not given, the entire scene is used. The 'geoRegion' parameter has precedence over this parameter.

referenceBand.name: referenceBand
referenceBand.description: The band used to indicate the pixel coordinates.

geoRegion.name: geoRegion
geoRegion.description: The subset region in geographical coordinates using WKT-format, e.g. POLYGON(({lon1} {lat1}, {lon2} {lat2}, ..., {lon1} {lat1})) (make sure to quote the option due to spaces in {geometry}). If not given, the entire scene is used.

subSamplingX.name: subSamplingX
subSamplingX.description: The pixel sub-sampling step in X (horizontal image direction)

subSamplingY.name: subSamplingY
subSamplingY.description: The pixel sub-sampling step in Y (vertical image direction)

fullSwath.name: fullSwath
fullSwath.description: Forces the operator to extend the subset region to the full swath.

vectorFile.name: vectorFile
vectorFile.description: The file from which the polygon is read.

polygonRegion.name: polygonRegion
polygonRegion.description: The subset region in geographical coordinates using WKT-format, e.g. POLYGON(({lon1} {lat1}, {lon2} {lat2}, ..., {lon1} {lat1})) If not given, the geometryRegion or pixelRegion is used.

copyMetadata.name: copyMetadata
copyMetadata.description: Whether to copy the metadata of the source product.

SnaphuExport.description: Export data and prepare conf file for SNAPHU processing

targetFolder.name: targetFolder
targetFolder.description: The output folder to which the data product is written.

statCostMode.name: statCostMode
statCostMode.description: Size of coherence estimation window in Azimuth direction

initMethod.name: initMethod
initMethod.description: Algorithm used for initialization of the wrapped phase values

numberOfTileRows.name: numberOfTileRows
numberOfTileRows.description: Divide the image into tiles and process in parallel. Set to 1 for single tiled.

numberOfTileCols.name: numberOfTileCols
numberOfTileCols.description: Divide the image into tiles and process in parallel. Set to 1 for single tiled.

numberOfProcessors.name: numberOfProcessors
numberOfProcessors.description: Number of concurrent processing threads. Set to 1 for single threaded.

rowOverlap.name: rowOverlap
rowOverlap.description: Overlap, in pixels, between neighboring tiles.

colOverlap.name: colOverlap
colOverlap.description: Overlap, in pixels, between neighboring tiles.

tileCostThreshold.name: tileCostThreshold
tileCostThreshold.description: Cost threshold to use for determining boundaries of reliable regions (long, dimensionless; scaled according to other cost constants). Larger cost threshold implies smaller regions---safer, but more expensive computationally.

SnaphuImport.description: Ingest SNAPHU results into InSAR product.

PhaseToDisplacement.description: Phase To Displacement Conversion along LOS

mapProjection.name: mapProjection
mapProjection.description: The coordinate reference system in well known text format

alignToStandardGrid.name: alignToStandardGrid
alignToStandardGrid.description: Force the image grid to be aligned with a specific point

standardGridOriginX.name: standardGridOriginX
standardGridOriginX.description: x-coordinate of the standard grid's origin point

standardGridOriginY.name: standardGridOriginY
standardGridOriginY.description: y-coordinate of the standard grid's origin point

nodataValueAtSea.name: nodataValueAtSea
nodataValueAtSea.description: Mask the sea with no data value (faster)

incidenceAngleForSigma0.name: incidenceAngleForSigma0
incidenceAngleForSigma0.default: Use projected local incidence angle from DEM
values: Use local incidence angle from DEM
Use projected local incidence angle from DEM

incidenceAngleForGamma0.name: incidenceAngleForGamma0
incidenceAngleForGamma0.default: Use projected local incidence angle from DEM
values: Use local incidence angle from DEM
Use projected local incidence angle from DEM

externalAuxFile.name: externalAuxFile
externalAuxFile.description: The antenne elevation pattern gain auxiliary data file.

Collocate.description: Collocates two products based on their geo-codings.

sourceProductPaths.name: sourceProductPaths
sourceProductPaths.description: A comma-separated list of file paths specifying the source products

referenceProductName.name: referenceProductName
referenceProductName.description: The name of the reference product.

targetProductType.name: targetProductType
targetProductType.description: The product type string for the target product (informal)

copySecondaryMetadata.name: copySecondaryMetadata
copySecondaryMetadata.description: Copies also the metadata of the secondary products to the target.

renameReferenceComponents.name: renameReferenceComponents
renameReferenceComponents.description: Whether or not components of the reference product shall be renamed in the target product.

renameSecondaryComponents.name: renameSecondaryComponents
renameSecondaryComponents.description: Whether or not components of the secondary product(s) shall be renamed in the target product.

referenceComponentPattern.name: referenceComponentPattern
referenceComponentPattern.description: The text pattern to be used when renaming reference components.

secondaryComponentPattern.name: secondaryComponentPattern
secondaryComponentPattern.description: The text pattern to be used when renaming secondary components.

resamplingType.name: resamplingType
resamplingType.description: The method to be used when resampling the secondary grid onto the reference grid.

BandMaths.description: Create a product with one or more bands using mathematical expressions.
